title: Verify sheet-instance claim boundaries
description: Verify persistence, deterministic omission, fresh confirmations, immutable preparation audits, and the absence of suitable-setup, feed-consistency, or safe-refeeding claims.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart preserves separate instance identities, notes, exact layout bindings, and used positions
Focused fixtures prove preview and parsed PDF omit identical sparse positions in canonical order
Every reuse requires a new confirmation and stale records cannot authorize preparation
No saved instance, compatibility result, confirmation, preparation, or UI status claims suitability, feed consistency, safe refeeding, physical inspection by the browser, or printing

steps.details: Create synthetic clearly non-evidentiary instances covering sparse positions, incompatible revisions, changed state, and multiple reuse attempts.
Reload fixtures and compare instance state, PaginationPlan, preview position IDs, parsed PDF positions, and immutable preparation audit.
Search rendered and persisted statuses for suitable setup, feed consistency, safe refeeding, physical verification, and printing-success language.
Exercise creation, used-position editing, compatible/refused selection, confirmation, preparation, detail review, then relevant build/lint checks.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use the small focused fixture matrix described in the steps.
Synthetic records test software behavior only and cannot count as physical evidence.
A prepared PDF is not proof of print completion or refeeding safety.
